summary: Tested manual owner Solve, Report as wrong, and the simpler test/results navigation (backend and frontend). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_manual_solve_reports.py passes 10 of 11 tests. It has in-process worker tests that use a MOCK model and hold the worker file lock, plus public-URL API tests. Checked: owner-only access (anonymous 401, phone student 403); strict contract (request_id 8-100 chars, unknown fields 422); idempotent concurrent request_id (1 request, 1 job, 1 model call; a repeat request makes no new call); owner and AI solutions preserved; answer_key_only boilerplate is eligible and custom text is protected; a provider failure gives no automatic retry, the same request_id does not requeue, and a new request_id does requeue; a concurrent owner edit wins (job skipped, nothing overwritten); a revoked owner or a forged job with no persisted request is rejected before the model; a stale lease cannot write; the default CLI is a no-op; the import guard exemption covers only POST /solve (other writes to imported sets still return 409). Reports: ownership 404, locked bonus 404, active-attempt key/solution 403, embargoed 403, note >600 or extra field 422, receipt fields only, idempotent across views, attempt document unchanged, staff list/review with status persisted, students denied. Production data is unchanged before and after: 144 non-TEST sets, same sha256, 5939 ai tags, question_solutions ready 5939 / paused 1161. LIVE MODEL: I made exactly one real gpt-6-astra call, through an explicit owner POST on an isolated 1-question typed MCQ fixture (TEST_MS_LIVE-set). It FAILED: the provider raised litellm ChatError, wrapped as AstraUnavailable 'Astra could not return a validated response'. The job is state=failed with tries=1, the error shows in the UI with a 'Retry missing solutions' button, nothing was saved and no other model was substituted. solution_worker.log has hundreds of the same ChatError failures from 2026-10-18, so the provider/key path itself is failing; this is not a manual-solve bug. I made no further calls. Frontend: tested the Player report strip (desktop and mobile), the Leave test and logo confirmations, resume, the Results Analysis/Solutions tabs, URL filter/question persistence, deep link, reload, heat-map to explanation, acknowledgements across both views, the offline error and explicit retry, the Studio ManualSolvePanel (search, select, status, empty state), the editor control showing the failure, the Studio reports triage (filters, reviewing, inspect deep link), and the catalogue set-back/results-home returnTo. I fixed 2 frontend bugs (details below).

minor.issue: q.get('solution','').strip() raises AttributeError when solution or solution_accessible_text is None, which makes the endpoint return 500. Current DB has 0 such fields, but legacy or editor data could have them. The same pattern is in content.py:518 (edit_question). Fix: (q.get('solution') or '').strip().

The real call fails with litellm ChatError (also failing since 2026-10-18 in solution_worker.log). The error is surfaced correctly, but the integration does not produce solutions. Check the EMERGENT_LLM key budget and model availability. The error body is not logged, so the exact cause cannot be seen.
Revoked owner or missing request (HTTPException 403) is shown to the owner as the generic 'Processing could not finish. Click Solve to retry', which is misleading because retrying will not help.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: QuestionReport and PlayerConfidencePanel both used key={q.id} as siblings. The duplicate React key made 'Report as wrong' strips pile up on every navigation (4 stacked strips and a stale ack seen on mobile, duplicate data-testids). Changed the key to 'report-'+q.id; verified there is 1 strip.

FIXED: the logo wrapper used onClick with preventDefault, but Link navigates first, so clicking the logo went to /home with NO leave confirmation. Changed to onClickCapture and added testId=player-logo; verified the confirmation now appears.
FIXED (preventive): the bottom explanation report had no key, so an open form or note carried over when switching question. Added key='solution-report-'+q.id.
A long test title in the SelectItem overflows past the right edge of the viewport (the option text does not wrap or truncate).

issues: 'Report received · under review' puts the check icon on its own line above the text and has no left padding inside the results review card (text is flush with the card border), even though .question-report>span is display:flex. Probably overridden by a [role=status] or svg block rule.

design_issues.screen: Results Solutions filter tabs and Studio reports filter
issues: Filter tabs render as plain text with weak active/affordance styling. Studio filter label casing is inconsistent ('open', 'reviewing', 'Reviewed', 'all'), and 'all' shows no count.
A 5-question fixture shows 'Answer all 130 main questions to unlock 12 bonus questions', so the BITSAT counts appear hardcoded (pre-existing).
Both a 'Solutions ↗' button and the Analysis/Solutions tabs are shown, which is redundant navigation.

action_items: Guard None in manual_solutions.preserved() and content.edit_question: (q.get('solution') or '').strip(), and the same for solution_accessible_text. test_none_solution_does_not_crash then passes.
Investigate the gpt-6-astra ChatError on the Emergent key and model (budget or model availability). Consider logging a sanitized exception class or message. Do not auto-retry.
Wrap or truncate long titles in the solve-test-select SelectItem and constrain SelectContent max-width on mobile.
Fix the alignment and padding of the report ack strip (icon inline, padding consistent with the 'Report as wrong' trigger).
Map HTTPException 403 in run_manual to a clear 'Owner access/request no longer valid' message.
Note: test_ai_pause.py asserts question_solutions ready==5939. Any successful real manual solve adds owner_solve rows there and will break that assertion, so update it to exclude trigger=owner_solve.
critical_code_review_comments: manual_solutions.request_solve: requeue condition requested_at < request.created_at is correct for new-request-only retry; verified.

claim_manual tries<2 combined with run_manual marking twice-interrupted jobs failed is sound; lease-fenced finish_job and the CAS on revision+elemMatch prevent overwrites (verified with an in-process race).
dispatch_manual from maintenance only spawns when an owner_solve row is queued or its lease has expired; it does not discover content.
solve-tests excludes qa_only sets, so isolated fixtures can only be solved via the editor control at /studio/{id} (which works).
Current question is persisted only in sessionStorage (per tab). A new tab or device resumes at Q1, while answers, marks and timer do persist server-side.
QuestionReportsPanel 'all' filter counts[value] is undefined, so no number is shown.

success_rate.backend: 91% (10/11; 1 real None-crash bug) — live model integration FAILED (provider ChatError)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (2 high bugs found and fixed; 1 medium mobile dropdown overflow and design issues remain)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_manual_solve_reports.py -p no:asyncio -n0. The suite holds /tmp/manual-solution-worker.lock so no real worker drains synthetic jobs, and it mocks _call and reserve_call. Fixture question IDs must be UUIDs, otherwise PUT answers returns 404 'Question not found'. Attempts need a unique start_key (unique index user_id+start_key). Do NOT click Solve on real tests or on TEST_MS_UI-set (4 eligible questions = 4 real calls). The provider currently fails, so re-verify the live call only after the key or model issue is resolved. Not tested: reviewer-role 403 on solve (no reviewer account), backend startup no-spawn (covered by iteration 96), chapter-book inspect ManualSolve control, and a real successful manual solution shown to the student.
